label: Piano individuale di risparmio (PIR ordinario)
Ordinarie PIR 2025: 40 000 EUR insättnin: Ordinary PIR 2025: EUR 40,000 annual and EUR 200,000 total contributions; withdrawals do not restore historical room. The provider must verify instrument, allocation, concentration and residence conditions. Five-year holding is assessed per contribution/security lot; opening date alone is insufficient. A mature withdrawal requires explicit provider confirmation for every withdrawn lot. Early closure requires exact provider-calculated tax recapture including interest and full closure. No general PIR tax relief is assumed from the opening date alone.
Faktisk anskaffningsdag / första insättn: Actual acquisition date / first deposit date
Leverantören har verifierat samtliga ord: The provider has verified all ordinary PIR conditions
Leverantören verifierar fem års innehav: The provider verifies five years of ownership for every withdrawn lot
Faktisk återföringsskatt inklusive ränta: Actual recapture tax including interest on early full closure (EUR)
Årets insättningar före prognosstart (EU: Contributions this year before the forecast starts (EUR)
Årets redan upplupna leverantörsberäknad: Provider-calculated recapture tax already accrued this year (EUR)
Ange faktisk anskaffningsdag för den end: Enter the actual acquisition date for the single share lot.
Ange verkliga livstidsinsättningar; de f: Enter actual lifetime contributions. They must cover the remaining contributed capital.
PIR-utdelning måste återinvesteras inom: Reinvest PIR dividends within the account.
Leverantörens PIR-behörighetsbekräftelse: Confirm that the provider has certified PIR eligibility.
Ange exakt leverantörsberäknad skatt/rän: Enter the exact provider-calculated tax and interest for early closure.
